sloka: ततस्तु वातोद्धतमेघकल्पं भुजङ्गराजोत्तमभोगबाहुम्।तमापतन्तं धरणीधराभमुवाच रामो युधि कुम्भकर्णम् ।। ६.६७.१३१ ।।
transliteration: tatastu vātoddhatameghakalpaṁ bhujaṅgarājottamabhogabāhum।tamāpatantaṁ dharaṇīdharābhamuvāca rāmo yudhi kumbhakarṇam ।। 6.67.131 ।।

translations.english: Let the bulls among Vanaras climb upon him and the foremost of Vanaras and the troops stand all over.
